بوست كاروسيل — 3 غلطات ترجّعلك المذكرة. 4 صور، 1080x1350 (فيد).
Order right to left: cover, headings, index, table. Post as ONE carousel, not four posts.

Each green line is a real capability: heading levels unified, the index built from headings with hyperlinked entries, RTL tables corrected. No page-number claim on the index slide — a freshly built index reads 1 until Word repaginates.
